bio: In this medieval edifice in historic Bergerac, the chef has been crafting seasonal cuisine of regional inspiration that packs a punch for over 15 years. In summer on the terrace or in winter by a huge fireplace, you will sample elegant, deftly curated dishes, such as panacotta of white asparagus, crab meat and aïoli or a chou craquelin (half chou – half macaroon) with Timut-flavoured stewed strawberries and basil ganache: the antithesis of imperfect in fact!...
